proposals.summary: Dynamic MoE on 910B4 reduced token/expert pairs by about 12.8% and accelerated expert GMM by about 8.85%, but direct sort+cumsum+boolean-compaction made whole-block latency 82-96% worse. Optimize/fuse routing before judging benefit from expert-compute savings.
Separate implementation rejection from paper rejection: the direct lowering was rejected, while the full-model paper result remained inconclusive because no usable real MoE checkpoint was available.

Paper-to-Ascend must first check architecture applicability. Do not prioritize MoE-specific methods for an installed dense model; prefer inference-time methods whose required mechanism exists in the local checkpoint/runtime.
Record Dynamic MoE as superseded/audit-only for the current dense objective and point maintainers to the active dense MTP and prefix-cache workstreams.
